In the USA, a human diploid-cell vaccine, an adsorbed rabies vaccine, or a purified chick embryo cell vaccine may be used for postexposure treatment.4 In previously unimmunised individu- als, a 1-mL dose of vaccine is given intramuscularly on days 0, 3, 7, 14, and 28, with rabies immunoglobulin as in the WHO schedule. In previously immunised individuals, two doses of vaccine are given on days 0 and 3, and rabies immunoglobulin is not required. 1. WHO. WHO expert committee on rabies: eighth report.
